facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: Opportunity for up to US$75K investment
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 有明确创业团队/项目，能说明产品、市场和团队；核心技术/产品与项目垂直领域匹配
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 未公开明确统一要求；按项目地点 New York City, US 和当期 cohort 安排确认。
facts_raw.International Founder: 可能接受国际 founder；需确认签证/现场要求
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；Climate / Energy；阶段以 Early stage 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目
facts_raw.Notes: 15-company fellowship with NYCEDC, Bank of America and Gunderson Dettmer; strong for critical-tech founders.

facts.Funding / Support: Opportunity for up to US$75K investment
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: An identifiable team or project with a clear explanation of its product, market and founders; The core technology or product must match the program vertical
facts.Strong-to-Have: Full-time founders, clear founder-market fit, a demonstrable MVP, customer validation and explicit milestones and funding needs.
facts.On-site / Attendance: No standard attendance requirement published. Confirm the current cohort arrangements for New York City, US.
facts.International Founder: International founders may be eligible; confirm visa and attendance requirements.
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa support published; participants must independently confirm lawful entry and stay for US or European activities.
facts.Application Materials: Team, company, product, market, traction and funding information; consult the current official application form.
facts.Public Contact Route: Use the official application. Do not infer private contact information when none is published.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; Climate / Energy; primarily at the Early stage stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses
facts.Notes: 15-company fellowship with NYCEDC, Bank of America and Gunderson Dettmer; strong for critical-tech founders.
